caseStudy.title: PMI Market(i)
caseStudy.lead: A technical audit of Market(i), an internal iPad and iPhone app for Philip Morris field teams in the Nordics, and a roadmap for maintaining its legacy Objective-C codebase.

findings.title: AFNetworking pinned below 1.9
findings.body: AFHTTPRequestOperation in 19 files, on a library that has had no support for years. Move networking to URLSession.

findings.title: ReactiveCocoa 2.5
findings.body: The Objective-C version of RAC is unmaintained. Replace its signals with Combine or async/await step by step.

findings.title: Fabric is shut down
findings.body: Crash reports still go through Fabric with CrashlyticsKit. Switch to Firebase Crashlytics.

findings.title: Debug tools in release builds
findings.body: PonyDebugger and the Reveal SDK are linked for every configuration. Limit them to Debug.

findings.title: UIAlertView in 17 files
findings.body: Deprecated since iOS 9. Replace with UIAlertController.

findings.title: No unit tests
findings.body: There is no test target yet. Start with the sync and the data mapping before changing them.

scene.summary: Review done: a maintenance plan from the riskiest dependencies down.

brief.title: The brief
text: Market(i) helps field teams photograph and share store shelves with hashtags and private tags, see stores on a map, follow share of market and work offline with sync. It had grown over years and was about to be handed over for maintenance.
I assessed the inherited codebase independently, so the client would know its condition and what keeping it alive would take.

contributions.title: What I reviewed
items: The features: shelf photos with tags, store map with clustering, share of market, segmentation, POS and sync.
The code: about 440 Objective-C files of its own, CocoaPods and Core Data.
Dependencies and SDKs, build settings and deployment targets.
Tooling, tests and debug libraries in every configuration.
A maintenance roadmap from urgent fixes to modernisation.

findings.title: Findings
findings.text: Each one confirmed in the code.

items.title: Networking on AFNetworking 1.x
items.text: Pinned below 1.9, with AFHTTPRequestOperation in 19 files.

items.title: Debug tools in every build
items.text: PonyDebugger and Reveal linked in all configurations, including release.

items.title: Deprecated SDKs
items.text: Fabric / CrashlyticsKit and the legacy Google Analytics SDK still in use.

items.title: Mismatched targets
items.text: The Podfile targets iOS 9 while the project targets iOS 12.4.

items.title: No unit tests
items.text: Every change has to be verified by hand.

team.title: Team
team.text: An independent assessment, in coordination with the project stakeholders.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A prioritised list of risks and a roadmap from urgent fixes to modernisation. The maintenance engagement itself did not go ahead.
